Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the APCRDA Assistant Manager-Legal recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the APCRDA Assistant Manager-Legal posts is 07 September 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Manager-Legal position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Assistant Manager-Legal post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 61960 per month. This is a contract-based position.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree in Law from a reputed institution. Additionally, a minimum of 5 years of post-qualification experience in specified legal fields is mandatory.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Manager-Legal post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the Assistant Manager-Legal position announced by the Andhra Pradesh Capital Region Development Authority (APCRDA) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, according to the official notification, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the APCRDA Assistant Manager-Legal role?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves an Application Review followed by Document Verification. Candidates are advised to ensure all their submitted documents are in order.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the APCRDA Assistant Manager-Legal recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to apply through the official website or the provided application link.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Assistant Manager-Legal position is offered on a contract basis. Candidates should be aware of the terms and duration of the contract as specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the APCRDA located?
faq.answer: The Andhra Pradesh Capital Region Development Authority (APCRDA) is located in Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh, with a pincode of 522237.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section on this page. It is highly recommended to download and read it thoroughly before applying.
